title: Curable resin composition containing fine polymer particles that has improved storage stability
abstract: Curable resin composition (II) comprising 1 to 100 parts by mass of a fine polymer particle (B), relative to 100 parts by mass of an epoxy resin (A), wherein the fine polymer particle has a core-shell structure, the core layer of the polymer fine particle is diene rubber, the epoxy group content of the polymer fine particle (B) is 0.01 to 0.15 mmol/g, the epoxy resin (A) comprises bisphenol A epoxy resin and rubber-modified epoxy resin and/or urethane-modified epoxy resin.
